The Pokémon TCG Gem Pack Vol. 3 is the latest release in China’s highly sought-after Gem Pack series, officially launched on September 26, 2025. This edition celebrates some of the Pokémon world’s most iconic nocturnal and ghost types, offering nine stunning Illustration Rare cards — including Gengar, Meowth, Cubone, Chandelure, and Ceruledge — all exclusive to this release and unlikely to see an international print.

Each booster pack contains four holo cards, with vibrant foil finishes that highlight the unique Chinese artwork. Perfect for serious collectors and fans of the Scarlet & Violet series, this release continues China’s trend of creating some of the most collectible and artistic cards in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

Whether you’re completing your collection, investing in rare cards, or looking for the perfect gift, Gem Pack Vol. 3 is a must-have addition for Pokémon TCG enthusiasts around the globe.
